reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what I never see on TikTok Shop, and that answers my first question about whether it is really tested. The money-back guarantee and the launch price make one box an easy impulse buy for an evening routine.
objection: I would want to actually open the lab report and see that the batch number matches. If the report is vague or the lab is a name I cannot check, it is just marketing again.
would_change_my_mind: The lab report not loading, or the batch number not matching the box.
